name: Sprig
description: Sprig is a product-experience research platform for in-product and long-form surveys, feedback, session replay, heatmaps, prototype testing, and AI-assisted insights.
agentUseSummary: Add a customer-owned Data Export API key, then let selected agents read a bounded, minimized study index. Relay does not expose questions, targeting constraints, cursors, responses, themes, users, visitor data, media, transcripts, metadata, or mutations.

providerSetup.blocker: No customer-owned Sprig account with Data Export API access, environment-specific API key, representative study, or safe fixture is available in this workspace.
providerSetup.nextAction: An authorized Sprig administrator obtains the intended environment's Data Export API key and stores it through Relay Console, then verifies the minimized study index, assignment, key replacement, disconnect, provider-side rotation, and post-disconnect denial.

evidence.supports: Sprig documents its API authentication, response format, environment-specific keys, and API rate limiting.
Sprig documents the survey/study configuration export, its 1,000-item maximum, cursor and status inputs, and question and targeting fields Relay strips and caps.
The response export can expose answers, user and visitor IDs, snapshots, URLs, metadata, deleted data, media, and transcripts, supporting Relay's exclusion of the endpoint.
The official OpenAPI schema pins `https://api.sprig.com`, Bearer API-key authentication, the V1 study export, response and theme exports, V2 user operations, and destructive visitor purge.
